what_was_done: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/coding/spec.md, tasks/coding/dev.json and the code_tests checker in lab/core.py.
Authored 21 bug-fix tasks (contract sentence, fenced buggy code, Symptom line, fix instruction, fixed format line), each with a different function and bug class; none reuse the dev functions.
Generated the file with a build script (kept in the session scratchpad, not in the repo).
verification: Every Symptom line was produced by executing the buggy code and the reference on the stated call(s) in a fresh namespace; the build asserts that the two results differ.

Every expected value in the asserts was computed by running the reference solution, not written by hand; the hand-written multi-statement tests (mutation, aliasing, mutable default) were executed against the reference.
The build asserts that the reference passes all asserts and that the unchanged buggy code (the negative) fails at least one.
Final check with the project validator, which runs reference and negative through the sandboxed code_tests checker.
not_done: The model was not run on these tasks (held-out, no pilot), so the easy/medium/hard labels are author estimates based on the spec's guidance, not measured pass rates.
Other generators' files were not read, so cross-generator overlap was not checked.
notes: g2-17 (find_index): a half fix (only changing the loop condition) loops forever and fails by the 8 s checker timeout.
g2-21 (is_palindrome): the symptom is an IndexError rather than a wrong return value.
